steps: 1. Host with bots, enable **Improved Bot Combat**, and open its advanced options.

2. Toggle the six children independently: **Smarter Attack Choices**, **Ping Attacking Elites**, **Limit Special Chasing**, **Ignore Distant Gunners**, **Limit Boss Over-Focus**, and **Smarter Career Ability Timing**. There is one ability-timing checkbox, not one for each career.
3. Exercise **Special Chase Distance (in meters)**, **Gunner Cover Distance (in meters)** and **Boss Engage Distance (in meters)** on both sides of their thresholds.
4. Turn off the Improved Bot Combat master and confirm native decisions return. Briefly swap a bot's weapon to exercise the missing-weapon guard.
5. Run `/gt_regression_test`, exit normally, and attach the newest log.
assertions: Disabling one child changes only its own behaviour family; disabling the master returns all six to native behaviour. The named control regression passes and weapon swapping does not crash. Attacker pinging in this candidate is elite-only; this card does not claim special/monster attacker-ping coverage.
Harness: per child toggle, feed bot blackboard an elite/special/boss attacker and assert ping and target decisions; policy truth table offline (test_gt_improved_bot_combat_controls.lua).
